performance: Avoid adding blocking work to Controller, Gateway, scheduler, or continuation hot paths without measured justification.
Long-running verification must use the existing Process Runtime and resource-compatible check scheduling rather than synchronous polling loops.
nonRegression: Preserve Controller-first authority: ChatGPT owns semantic decisions while Forge owns deterministic execution, evidence, and lower-layer lifecycle enforcement.
Do not introduce a second durable writer for Requirement, Plan, Work, ControllerRound, Workflow Supervisor, or repository execution state.
Do not weaken registered verification, implementation review, approval, or repository safety gates to obtain progress.
External effects with ambiguous outcome must reconcile before retry; blind replay is forbidden.
Architecture authority and implementation must remain synchronized.

Use root-cause-first batch convergence: cluster related symptoms before mutation and prefer one coherent common-cause correction over symptom-by-symptom patches; emergency containment must remain narrow and return to root-cause closure.
Cognitive learning may guide future Work only through portable semantic scope and must not silently override product/domain contracts, architecture authority, authorization, or verification gates.

checks.purpose: Compile the root TypeScript graph and Workflow Supervisor TypeScript graph without emitting output.
Enforce source-level runtime ownership and architecture guardrails.
Detect architecture and implementation drift for changed capabilities.

tooling.purpose: TypeScript compile-time validation for repository changes.
Bounded execution and verification with durable process evidence when commands outlive the interaction budget.
